transport.evidence: NetworkHTTP$$Request 0x17b5a44; ARM64 0x17b5ba0..0x17b5bb4 selects Post=2 for a default Get=0 request with non-null serialized postData
transport.session_auth: Request bodies carry session_id; replacement SSE decodes it from token query JWT payload without verifying signature
transport.reconnect: Observed Android 2.41.0 diagnostic profile: interrupted stream shows ES_CLOSED; Play performs a new login and SSE GET without Last-Event-ID/since. OnRetryHandler statically returns false. Other interruption modes unverified; see movement-and-reconnect.md.

udp.status: Client codec recovered; optional research PHP relay verified with one Android emulator plus synthetic peer. Two Android clients and production movement authority remain unverified.
udp.receive_datagram: One or more concatenated 24-byte records; other lengths ignored by client.

layout.meaning: Canonical network-order GUID: session ID outbound from client; player ID on relay deliveries to client, verified by synthetic peer avatar in Android.
Little-endian bit field: bits 0..11 are six 2-bit inverse steps (newest first), bits 12..15 are count; counts above six give empty history.
Direction: NONE=0 RIGHT=1 LEFT=2 UP=3 DOWN=4.

udp.sequence_rule: (new>old and new-old<=127) or (old>new and old-new>127); equality discarded.
